description: This file implements the Simulator class and its associated methods for a QUIC protocol testing framework, including scheduling, actor management, and simulation control.

classes.name: Simulator
classes.description: Main class managing simulation of QUIC actors and events.

classes.name: Simulator::Clock
classes.description: Provides current time references within the simulation.

classes.name: Simulator::RunForDelegate
classes.description: Handles stopping the simulation after a specified duration.

methods.name: AddActor
methods.description: Adds an actor to the simulation.

methods.name: RemoveActor
methods.description: Removes an actor from the simulation.

methods.name: Schedule
methods.description: Schedules an actor at a specific time.

methods.name: Unschedule
methods.description: Removes an actor from the schedule.

methods.name: GetRandomGenerator
methods.description: Returns the random generator, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: RunFor
methods.description: Runs the simulation for a specified duration.

methods.name: HandleNextScheduledActor
methods.description: Processes the next scheduled actor event.
